description: The StoryOS Runners YOU own (a Runner is a program on your own computer that wakes your agents inside your own Claude Code, on your own subscription), each with status, connection (online, offline, paused, outdated, tool_missing, revoked), working hours, reserve and hold. An agent set to "Your own AI" with no active, online Runner waits, which is the usual reason an agent is not running. Only your own, never a colleague's. Adding or changing a Runner is done by a person in StoryOS (Settings, Runners); there is deliberately no tool for it. [Full notes: get_started section "TOOL NOTES list_runners"]
name: list_runners
title: List my Runners
